data.label: Cross-Platform Frameworks (React Native / Flutter)
data.description: Build native iOS and Android apps from a unified codebase using React Native (JavaScript/TypeScript) or Flutter (Dart).

data.label: Native iOS (Swift & SwiftUI)
data.description: Master Swift 5, SwiftUI declarative views, Combine reactive pipelines, CoreData persistence, and Apple Human Interface Guidelines.

data.label: Native Android (Kotlin & Jetpack Compose)
data.description: Master modern Android development: Kotlin Coroutines for async execution, Jetpack Compose declarative UI, ViewModel, and Room database.

data.label: Offline Data, Caching & SQLite
data.description: Design resilient mobile experiences with offline caching, local SQLite storage, optimistic UI updates, and background sync workers.

data.label: Hardware APIs & Store Deployment
data.description: Interface with mobile hardware: Push Notifications (FCM/APNs), Biometric FaceID/Fingerprint auth, Camera/Photo library, and App Store release pipelines with Fastlane.
data.codeSnippet:
# Fastlane iOS & Android Deployment Command
fastlane release
# Automates code signing, screenshots, TestFlight upload, and production store release
